answer: A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the signal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
